rix.text: Bablovia is presented through a classroom's oral projects, in which Anabelle explains that it is currently a pentarchy of five organizations.

The Order of the Widget is led by the machine Grand Calcutron, who began as Calvin Granderson, a man who replaced his left hand with a toaster and then most of his body, while S.N.E.A.K. began as a job-share board and Steamflogger Industries became the Goblin Explosioneers when goblins took over the factory.

The League began as a supervillain support group, and it once blackmailed the other factions with a weather machine, while the Crossbreed Labs grew from scientists who accidentally gave a subject a tail, and Dr. Jumblemorph won politicians over to make it a government of its own.
The class ends with Stewart's claim that squirrels secretly run all five factions.
